---
title: "Installing ProteoVaultR"
---

## 1. Install ProteoVaultR

Run the following commands in R to install the package and its dependencies.

```{r install-package, eval=FALSE}
install.packages(c("BiocManager", "remotes"))

BiocManager::install(
    c("limma", "S4Vectors", "SummarizedExperiment"),
    ask = FALSE,
    update = FALSE
)

remotes::install_github("TheBoutrosLab/package-ProteoVaultR")
```

::: {.alert .alert-info role="note"}
**Note:** ProteoVaultR requires DuckDB 2.0 or newer and dbplyr 2.6 or newer.
The package declares these requirements and checks them during installation.
:::

## 2. Check the installation

Load the package and check which version is installed:

```{r check-installation, eval=FALSE}
library(ProteoVaultR)
packageVersion("ProteoVaultR")
```

If the package loads without an error and R prints a version number, you are
ready to begin. You can also open the help page for the function used to connect
to a database:

```{r open-help, eval=FALSE}
?open_vault
```

## 3. Get the demo data

Next, follow [Downloading the demo data](demo-data.html) to choose a DIA, DDA LFQ,
or TMT example database and save it for your analyses.
